root_cause.text: The netfs read retry code uses an uninitialized or stale `subreq` pointer when jumping to the abandonment label, causing the abandonment loop to operate on incorrect subrequests and discard all remaining ones prematurely.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `subreq = from;` before the first `goto abandon;` (line 96-97) and `subreq = NULL;` after discarding superfluous retryable subrequests (line 183). The commit message states that “the abandonment process expects the 'subreq' variable to be set to the place to start abandonment from, but it doesn't always have a useful value (it will be uninitialised on the first pass through the loop and it may point to a deleted subrequest on later passes).”
